snippet.title: Horror Tolerance Test Gameplay PC
snippet.description:
🎮 Horror Tolerance Test – PC Gameplay
👻 Can you survive fear itself?

Face three unique horror challenges in this experimental game that diagnoses your tolerance for fear. Test your skills in Surprise Horror, Hide Horror, and Escape Horror. With difficulty scaling based on your memory, judgment, and observation, every run is scarier than the last!
